bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qvm_su_bank_native #(.MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_native_physical_20261015/qvm_su_bank_hard_native.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qvm_su_bank_native/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qvm_su_bank_native/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qvm_su_bank_native --out {RUN}/record/views/qvm_su_bank_native --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qvm_data256_native/views/qvm_data256_native --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qvm_su_bank_ctrl_native/views/qvm_su_bank_ctrl_native > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: su4 (supersedes su3, owner rule 20:45 visual check of su2: 37% fill with a 35-um empty top band, ctrl in its own row): 371.52 x 220.32 (was 241.92 tall: -9% area, ~40% fill; the six 512-pin data leaves and the 20-um macro/pin-face rules bound it), ctrl moved into the left column between u_in_lo and a raised u_in_hi (20-um channels); hi macro R180 so both macro clk pins sit near the S (lo) / N (hi) faces with ck_mem_lo S and ck_mem_hi N directly at them; ck_cap N (later capture; cap->out +358 ps), ck_out S under the out leaves. su1 -8.81 / su2 -2.70 were only the 1024x256 macro rd_out (561 ps) -> capture with long mem entry wires (63.8 / 76.9 ps). Same RTL/children/entries, 0 cycles.
